text:
Plate looks about 22-26 cm wide. It holds 5 sausage patty slices (about 15 g each, so roughly 75 g), raspberries (about 10 berries, roughly 50 g), and roasted sweet potato and squash cubes (about 100 g).

Energy: sausage patties about 75 g × 2.5 kcal/g ≈ 190 kcal, raspberries about 25 kcal, and roasted sweet potato with oil about 100 g × 1.3 kcal/g ≈ 130 kcal. The total is about 345 kcal, so I'd round down to roughly 320 kcal.

Mass: 75 + 50 + 100 = 225 g.
